blind.description: A low cluster of stylized, mossy boulders consisting of one dominant rounded rock surrounded by three smaller rocks nestled tightly against its base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and gently faceted with hand-painted stylized texturing. The stones intersect naturally into a single cohesive clump resting directly on the ground without an added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: An irregular rounded cluster resembling a three-lobed or four-lobed clump, dominated by one large faceted stone on one side flanked by smaller rounded stones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/3 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.5 to 2 ft tall) and roughly half as wide as a 5-ft grid tile (around 2.5 to 3 ft across).

notes: height is slightly squatter than catalog proportions (2.4 ft vs 3.7 ft intended)
